observedResult: The prior CORAL Phase 2b IPF cough trial NCT05964335 randomized 165 patients (160 in primary analysis): six-week objectively measured 24-hour cough count fell 60.2% with nalbuphine ER 108 mg twice daily versus 16.9% placebo; log scale placebo difference -1.03 (95% CI -1.48 to -0.58), p<0.001. uncertaintyReview: Prior Phase 2b with 160 analyzed, three dose arms, and protocol sensitivity questions; the 52-week OCEAN-1 primary estimand and longer-term treatment effect have not been observed. Objective cough reduction does not itself establish survival or functional benefit.
